description: MUTATES public notable_people. Superuser only. Patch by slug (bio, about, occupation, birth_place, birth_date, net_worth, residence, before_fame, trivia, family_life, zodiac, flag). Rejects unknown fields. No create/delete. Stamps last_updated_via=mcp. ($0.10; API key required)

about.description: Long-form about text for the notable, e.g. Theoretical physicist who developed the theory of relativity.

before_fame.description: Free text about the notable's life before fame, e.g. Worked as a patent clerk in Bern.

bio.description: Short biography of the notable, e.g. German-born physicist known for relativity.

birth_date.description: YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD. Null/empty clears

birth_place.description: Birth place text, e.g. Ulm, Germany.

family_life.description: Free text about the notable's family life, e.g. Married twice, two sons.

flag.description: Country flag emoji for the notable, e.g. 🇩🇪.

net_worth.description: Net worth text for the notable, e.g. $1.2 billion (2024).

occupation.description: Occupation or job title, e.g. Engineer.

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

residence.description: Where the notable lives, e.g. Palo Alto, California.

trivia.description: Trivia text about the notable, e.g. Played violin from age six.

zodiac.description: Western zodiac sign of the notable, e.g. Pisces.

name: update_notable

account.description: The Dayze account this data belongs to. With more than one Dayze connection, name it in the answer.

note.description: How to disclose the account to the user.

qa_fixture.description: True for a known QA test account: its records are fixture data, not a real life.

changed.description: Changed fields with before and after values.

provenance.description: Which connector wrote the record and which connected Dayze account received it.

name.description: The connected app or API-key label shown to the account owner.
